question: Can one explicit third-order phase coupling close the excursion-topology gap left by P4CM while preserving the exact P4BS Thomas power spectrum on wholly new archival sources?

development.role: consumed P4CM sources used only to choose one global coupling coefficient

confirmation.selection_rule: Sort eligible first clips with ten PNG frames and select indices 16 through 19; no confirmation pixel may be read before the coefficient and model statistics freeze.

patch_observation.residual_normalization: subtract mean and divide by population RMS

candidate.name: hermite3_phase_projected_compound_thomas_v1
candidate.construction: normalize the fixed P4CL compound field x, form x + alpha*(x^3-3x), retain its Fourier phase, replace every non-DC magnitude with the exact P4BS Thomas magnitude, inverse transform and normalize
candidate.fit_rule: minimize median four-source high-order feature distance; ties within 1e-12 choose smaller absolute alpha then smaller signed alpha
candidate.feature_distance: RMS feature-median difference scaled by the fixed Gaussian-control MAD floor 1e-6

branch_rule.pass: Retain the one-parameter phase-coupled Thomas field as a generic high-order research mechanism and open disjoint photographic severe-artifact stress.
branch_rule.fail: Close this exact Hermite coupling, grid and inherited compound envelope without threshold or parameter rescue.

forbidden: read any confirmation pixel before alpha and model statistics freeze
fit alpha per source or use confirmation rows for selection
change the alpha grid, inherited P4CL envelope, features or 20 percent gate after fitting
claim stock, emulsion, scanner, process, physical calibration, visual safety or product readiness
claim_ceiling: Fresh-source archival-code phase-coupling evidence only; no stock, physical calibration, scanner separation, visual safety or product claim.
